company_profile.name: NorthPeak Mechanical Services
company_profile.core_product_or_service: Commercial HVAC installation, repair, and preventative maintenance
company_profile.notes: All company details are fictional and for illustrative purposes only.

scenario_analysis.base_case_summary: Existing commercial clients adopt automation upgrades gradually; steady service add-ons from maintenance relationships.
scenario_analysis.optimistic_case_summary: Provincial energy incentives accelerate adoption; strong pull-through from existing maintenance clients.
scenario_analysis.conservative_case_summary: Budget constraints slow adoption but opportunity remains viable due to low capital requirements and strong existing relationships.
scenario_analysis.notes: Scenario descriptions are qualitative and directional only. They do not represent forecasts, guarantees, or financial advice.

opportunity_object.headline: Launch Building Automation and Energy Optimization Services for existing commercial maintenance clients.
opportunity_object.signal: Increased client inquiries about energy efficiency and new provincial automation incentives creating time-limited window.
opportunity_object.why_now: Regulatory pressure and utility rebates have created a 12–18 month window for automation upgrades before competitors establish monitoring contracts.
opportunity_object.asset_advantage: NorthPeak already controls the mechanical systems that building automation depends on. Existing service contracts and technician familiarity with building infrastructure reduce entry friction to near-zero.
opportunity_object.adjacent_opportunity: Building automation system (BAS) installation, monitoring, and energy optimization services offered as an add-on layer to existing maintenance contracts.

revenue_upside.assumptions_summary: Based on typical adoption patterns among existing commercial maintenance clients with 50+ locations under contract. Directional only — not a forecast.

opportunity_object.cost_of_waiting: Competitors offering automation packages will secure long-term monitoring contracts first, converting NorthPeak's maintenance clients into locked accounts for a competitor.
opportunity_object.buyer_profile: Property managers, commercial building owners, and facility directors already under NorthPeak maintenance contracts.
risk_flags: Technician upskilling required for BAS platforms
Vendor platform selection risk — wrong platform creates lock-in
Client budget cycles may delay capital upgrades
Scope creep if automation and maintenance responsibilities overlap ambiguously

time_window.timing_notes: Timing is contextual and directional only. Not predictive.

entry_path_90_days.days_1_30: Train two senior technicians on a leading BAS platform. Create a simple automation audit checklist for existing sites. Identify the 10 highest-value clients for pilot outreach.
entry_path_90_days.days_31_60: Run automation audits with top 10 clients. Present findings and automation upgrade proposals. Refine service scope based on client feedback.
entry_path_90_days.days_61_90: Secure 2–3 initial automation upgrade projects. Introduce monitoring subscription add-on. Establish pricing model for ongoing BAS monitoring.
entry_path_90_days.disclaimer: Exploratory operational steps only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice.

reasoning_signature.initial_signal: Multiple clients asking about energy savings programs and provincial automation rebates in the same quarter.
reasoning_signature.multiplier_dimension_sensed: Adjacent Market Expansion — specifically the monitoring and analytics archetype.
reasoning_signature.non_obvious_connection: NorthPeak technicians already gather building performance data during routine maintenance visits. The data layer for automation already exists — it just isn't packaged as a service.
reasoning_signature.disqualifying_risks_checked: Capital intensity is low — no new fleet or facilities required. Technician training is manageable with one vendor platform. Liability is controllable with clear scope definition.
reasoning_signature.strongest_reason_it_works: NorthPeak already controls the mechanical systems that building automation depends on. A new entrant would need to establish trust, gain site access, and learn the building systems NorthPeak already knows.
reasoning_signature.transferable_lesson: Service companies with recurring maintenance contracts can expand into monitoring and automation with minimal friction because they already control the systems the monitoring depends on. The data layer is a natural extension of the access they already have.
